Override order

THEMES-1 fixed order for any token: the highest layer that supplies a value wins. Same probe element in every card; only which layers are active changes.

1 · instance 2 · component 3 · global 4 · baked

Baked defaults

Model / tokens.css only. Component token aliases global scale.

layer: baked · --probe-bg → --surface-1

Global theme

Theme scale overrides --surface-1; component still aliases it.

layer: global · scale leaf wins via alias

Component tokens

Theme modes.*.component.* sets --probe-bg directly.

layer: component · beats global alias

Instance (style/channels)

Host style / channels override the component CSS var on this element only.

layer: instance · host wins

Studio Components facet shows the resolved layer for each token (Layer · {layer}). Helpers: THEME_OVERRIDE_ORDER, resolveOverrideLayer, resolveTokenLayer in @ship/tokens/theme-schema.
